THE SPARK

Why this one?

I wanted to see what happens when you take an instrument designed for music and give every knob, pad, fader, and key a completely different purpose. Could the Arturia MiniLab 3 become an airplane cockpit?

THE BUILD

How it works

A browser-based F-16-inspired flight experiment controlled with an Arturia MiniLab 3 via Web MIDI. Piano keys, pads, knobs, faders and touch controls can change flight state and mission actions. It includes snowy terrain, cockpit and exterior cameras, a flight-data lab and recorded telemetry.

JavaScript · Three.js · Web MIDI · Vite

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • MIDI-mapped throttle, controls and aerial stunts
  • Cockpit, chase and cinematic views
  • Mission challenges and telemetry playback

CURRENT CHAPTER

Progress & evidence

The repository contains a 69-second real controller demo and a public playable build.
